column6: Bullet 4 credited collisions with mixing types across the belt; belt-wide mixing is attributed to orbital/migration processes. Reworded and hedged.
Checked CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O balances.
Bullet 2 said "the same UV" reaches Earth and Titan (Titan gets ~1% of Earth's flux) and implied UV strength is irrelevant. Now: UV sets rates, molecules set products; "sunlight".
Note only: Q0 option/explanation say CH4 and O2 are mutually destroyed in "thousands of years"; CH4 lifetime in Earth's air is ~10 yr and O2 is not depleted. Not edited.
Worked f = 2Omega sin(lat): Jupiter/Venus Omega ratio ~590, so ~2.8 orders of magnitude. Dishpan regimes correct.
Superrotation-by-waves stated firmly, but matches Explainer and consensus that eddies/waves drive it.
Eastward offset -> peak before secondary eclipse: correct.
Worked v_rms at 1000 K: H2 3.53 km/s, N2 0.94 km/s.
Jeans parameter proportional to m; Earth lambda ~14 (H2) vs ~196 (N2), so tens of orders of magnitude. Correct.
Worked hc/240 nm = 5.17 eV vs O2 D0 ~5.1 eV; four Chapman reactions correct.
Bullet 2 said a molecule "responds only" to wavelengths able to break it; molecules absorb longer wavelengths without dissociating. Now "can be split only by".
Worked: dry parcel 10.2 C vs 13 C env (sinks); saturated 15 C vs 13 C (rises).
O2 + CO without CH4 is the standard abiotic-O2 discriminant.
Precision only: ozone "tracks" O2 implied proportionality (O3 is nonlinear in O2); now "depends on".
Stripe exercise said "spreading rate of 5 cm/yr"; spreading rate usually means full rate, which gives 2 Myr, not 1 Myr. Now specifies the plate moves away from the ridge at 5 cm/yr.
Core Idea called simple craters "dome-shaped"; they are bowl-shaped (as the Explainer says).
Central-peak analogy named the "crown splash"; the rebound analog is the central jet.
Worked Q scalings; P = a^1.5: 11.2 yr at 5 AU, 354 yr at 50 AU.

Ranking four magmas was not determinable: the 45%-crystal basalt vs andesite/rhyolite order is ambiguous. Now ranks three melts and explains separately why the crystal-rich basalt is far stiffer than crystal-free basalt.
Bullet 1 correction overcorrected: said viscosity and pressure "decide" explosivity, dismissing water content, which also matters. Belief now "is all that decides"; correction "also help decide".

Core Idea said explosive eruptions "dominate small bodies"; contradicts Explainer (lunar maria are effusive flood basalts). Now "small airless bodies can also erupt explosively". Note: Q1 explanation ("composition barely matters") is also overstated; not edited.
Worked H: 217 km (hot Jupiter), 8.4 km (Earth).
Said the radius valley was established from a bimodal density distribution; it was found from the radius distribution (Fulton et al. 2017).
2^(1/3) = 1.26; 5 M_E rocky ~1.5 R_E consistent with Explainer.
Math correct (1%; 2x70000x1000/7e5^2 = 286 ppm). Clarity: labeled 70,000 and 700,000 km as radii so the step is not read as diameters.
Hedge only: added "typically" to the ppm range (puffy planets can exceed it).
Worked tau = 9.81 Pa (Earth), 3.71 Pa (Mars).
Hedge only: Titan bedrock "is thought to be" water ice.
Grid works when filled (fission matches iron and isotopes but not angular momentum).
Bullet 2 said the Sun is "30% brighter now than when it formed"; the young Sun was ~30% fainter (~70% of today), i.e. today is ~40% brighter. Fixed.
Hedge only: ring-forming mechanism "is thought to" be concentric faulting. Note: Explainer's claim that the impact thermal pulse explains later mare filling is doubtful; not edited.
Said rock flows "under megapascals" of shock pressure; fluid-like behavior needs gigapascals (Explainer: hundreds of GPa).
Worked H/2R: Earth 0.063%, Mars 0.16% (Vickery-Melosh tangent-plane mass).
Note: older Q1/Q4 state the Moon-forming impact stripped the primordial atmosphere as settled; contested, not edited.
29.46/11.86 = 2.48. Two-curve framing is good.

Bullet 3 called the Nice-model LHB "the leading explanation" and limited the debate to timing; whether a spike happened at all is now widely disputed. Fixed. Note: Core Idea, Explainer, and Q2/Q3 still present the LHB spike as established fact (Q3 answer key depends on it); needs a separate revision.
Bullets are right; older Q1 option and Explainer conflate stagnant lid with convection stopping (note only).

Answer key said stagnant-lid transition makes outgassing cease (true); wrong (Mars is stagnant-lid yet volcanically active long after) and contradicted the new mis bullet 3. Answer set to false and explanation rewritten.
More radiogenic heating per unit volume for larger planets is wrong (per-volume heat depends on composition); now "relative to surface area". Same fix in Explainer paragraph 1.
